candidates.snippet: ### Motivation.  Would the vLLM community be interested in a general, opt-in mechanism to quantize the **target model's output LM head** online? candidates.title: [Roadmap] Hybrid State Cache Management for Agentic Workloads (FlashStates)
candidates.snippet: ## Overview  This issue tracks the integration of the FlashStates cache-management methods into SGLang, as a series of small PRs that are easy to review.  On a hybrid model (full attention next to Mamba / GDN / KDA layers), a cached prefix can be resumed only at a node that still holds a recurrent state. candidates.title: mimo-v2.6:9b tool_calls arrive with empty arguments (mimo_v2 renderer/parser drops function.arguments)
candidates.snippet: ## What is the issue?  `mimo-v2.6:9b` (mimo_v2 renderer/parser, support added in v0.40.15) returns `tool_calls` where `function.arguments` is empty (`{}`) in the vast majority of calls — the model names the tool but the arguments payload is missing. On the rare calls that do carry arguments, the payload is complete and correct, so the model is capable and this looks like a renderer/parser emission bug specific to the mimo_v2 integration.  Measured against a tool with a single required parameter
